claim: Measure selector-free ordinary C1/P8192+G256 decode and its same-session streaming ceiling after the block-size family was directly rejected. This package does not itself prove physical HBM saturation or stall freedom.

layer0.public_op: ordinary Qwen3.8-27B decode; the dominant owner is A8G64 x packed-Q4G64 Linear at T=1
layer0.represented_inputs: signed A8 represented as low/high Q4 planes plus FP16 G64 activation scales; signed packed Q4 N16/K16 weights plus FP16 G64 row scales; BF16 output
layer0.oracle: the sealed cold block+pipeline sweep checks all seven production tuples against an independent represented-formula FP64 oracle and full-output bit parity; this baseline package does not rerun the closed direct candidate family
layer0.baseline: selector-free current source bound by bound-plan.json; unprofiled auto C1/P8192+G256, three independent measured processes
layer0.suspected_limit: weight-stream bandwidth and latency hiding in the 321 T=1 dot8 calls per ordinary round
layer0.mechanism_decision: deferred until this baseline and a separately qualified challenger exist; profiler counters are attribution-only

useful_byte_contract.formula_per_call: N*Kpad/2 weight-code bytes + N*(Kpad/64)*2 weight-scale bytes + Kpad activation-code bytes + (Kpad/64)*2 activation-scale bytes + 4 status bytes + N*2 BF16 output bytes
useful_byte_contract.interpretation: exact unique represented bytes at the Linear boundary; not physical HBM traffic and not source-level repeated load requests

same_session_stream_probe.interpretation: isolated auto-state streaming ceiling, not inference traffic

focused_optional_profile.workload: C1/P8192+G1 ordinary, one measured region after one warmup

cold_shape_measurement.contract: all seven exact production shapes; identical immutable weight contents rotated across disjoint allocations totaling more than 64 MiB; independent represented-formula oracle and bit-exact route parity retained
cold_shape_measurement.interpretation: direct unprofiled auto-state evidence rejected both tested mechanisms. The block-size family had only one small local win and a sub-0.1% call-weighted whole bound. The one-group-ahead pipeline was 0.9971x to 1.0245x block256 across the seven shapes, within noise or slower. No compile selector was retained.

review_gate: After prepare.py creates bound-plan.json, independently review source identity, selector-free cache, commands, retained cold sweep, useful-byte formula, output freshness, power restoration, and decision language before either GPU action.
